title: Training Non-Differentiable Networks via Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2605.01928v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We optimize losses that jump: spiking thresholds, quantized layers, and discrete routing put jumps in the forward pass, where backpropagation does not apply. Finite differences fail: at a derivative-estimating radius, 99.5% of probe pairs on a quantized network leave the loss bit-identical, against 1.6% on a smooth control. At a jump, Clarke and conservative stationarity are undefined, and any radius-$h$ smoothing steepens like $1/h$, so no vanishing radius defines a derivative. Fixed-resolution stationarity survives. PolyStep attains it from forward passes alone, ranking probe points on a rotated polytope and stepping along a softmax-weighted average of their directions, the $\lambda=0$ endpoint of a KL-penalized transport program. A second impossibility fixes the frame: on a plateau wider than the probes reach, every rule that reweights one cost row freezes, softmax included, and only the column constraint escapes. translated_title: 通过最优传输训练不可微分网络
translated_abstract: 我们优化那些具有跳跃性的损失函数：尖峰阈值、量化层和离散路由在前向传播中引入跳跃，反向传播在此不适用。有限差分方法失效：在导数估计半径下，量化网络上99.5%的探测对损失结果完全相同，而平滑控制仅有1.6%。在跳跃点，Clarke和保守平稳性未定义，任何半径为h的平滑化会以1/h的速率陡增，因此不存在消失半径来定义导数。固定分辨率平稳性仍然成立。PolyStep仅通过前向传播即可达到该平稳性，它在旋转多胞体上对探测点进行排序，并沿其方向的softmax加权平均值步进，这是KL惩罚传输程序的λ=0端点。第二个不可能性固定了框架：在比探测范围更宽的平台上，任何重新加权单一成本行的规则（包括softmax）都会冻结，只有列约束得以逃脱。在期望中，
tldr: 本文提出PolyStep方法，通过最优传输理论仅利用前向传播即可训练具有跳跃性损失的非可微网络，解决了反向传播不适用的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PolyStep, a method that trains non-differentiable networks with jumping losses using only forward passes via optimal transport, overcoming the inapplicability of backpropagation.
